title: Sum Aggregation Baseline vs CAMA on rel-amazon/item-ltv (3 methods × 5 seeds)
summary: Demo notebook comparing GNN aggregation methods (sum, mean, CAMA) on rel-amazon/item-ltv. Demonstrates the CAMAAggregation module (NumPy reference implementation) with synthetic data, reproduces the statistical analysis (Cohen's d=13.58, p<1e-8) from pre-computed per-seed MAE values, and visualizes results across experimental iterations. Shows CAMA achieves 8% MAE improvement over mean baseline. Uses pre-computed results from the original PyTorch+torch_geometric experiment.
